--- output/lab/README.md ---
# Authoritative DNS and HTTP lab

Start the lab with `kathara lstart`.  The client (`client`) uses `dns`
(192.168.10.53) as its resolver.  That server is authoritative for
`service.local` and returns 192.168.20.80, the address of `web`.

Verification from the client:

```sh
dig @192.168.10.53 service.local A
getent hosts service.local
curl http://service.local/
```

Both routers use only the static routes in their startup files.  The DNS and
web-server configurations are stored under their respective machine
directories and are installed when each machine starts.

--- output/lab/lab.conf ---
# Client reaches an HTTP server by name through an authoritative local DNS server.
# LAN-A: 192.168.10.0/24   Transit: 10.0.12.0/30   LAN-B: 192.168.20.0/24
r1[0]="lan-a"
r1[1]="r1-r2"
r2[0]="r1-r2"
r2[1]="lan-b"
client[0]="lan-a"
dns[0]="lan-a"
web[0]="lan-b"

r1[image]="kathara/base"
r2[image]="kathara/base"
client[image]="kathara/base"
dns[image]="kathara/base"
web[image]="kathara/base"

--- output/lab/client.startup ---
#!/bin/sh
set -e
ip link set eth0 up
ip addr add 192.168.10.10/24 dev eth0
ip route add default via 192.168.10.1
printf 'search service.local\nnameserver 192.168.10.53\noptions timeout:1 attempts:2\n' > /etc/resolv.conf

# Tools used by the verification commands in the lab guide.
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y dnsutils curl

--- output/lab/dns.startup ---
#!/bin/sh
set -e
ip link set eth0 up
ip addr add 192.168.10.53/24 dev eth0
ip route add default via 192.168.10.1

# The configuration and zone are versioned with the lab and mounted at /shared.
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y bind9 bind9utils
install -d -o bind -g bind /etc/bind/zones
install -m 0644 -o root -g bind /shared/named.conf /etc/bind/named.conf
install -m 0644 -o root -g bind /shared/db.service.local /etc/bind/zones/db.service.local
named-checkconf
named-checkzone service.local /etc/bind/zones/db.service.local
service named restart

--- output/lab/dns/named.conf ---
options {
        directory "/var/cache/bind";
        listen-on { 192.168.10.53; };
        listen-on-v6 { none; };
        recursion yes;
        allow-query { 192.168.10.0/24; };
        dnssec-validation no;
};

zone "service.local" {
        type master;
        file "/etc/bind/zones/db.service.local";
        allow-transfer { none; };
};

--- output/lab/dns/db.service.local ---
$TTL 86400
@       IN      SOA     dns.service.local. admin.service.local. (
                        2026081201 ; serial
                        3600       ; refresh
                        900        ; retry
                        604800     ; expire
                        86400      ; negative cache TTL
                        )
        IN      NS      dns.service.local.
dns     IN      A       192.168.10.53
@       IN      A       192.168.20.80
www     IN      A       192.168.20.80
